By Data Skrive ,

On Thursday, Josh Jung and the Texas Rangers (44-43) open a series versus Kevin McGonigle and the Detroit Tigers (38-49) at Globe Life Field, with first pitch scheduled for 8:05 p.m. ET.
Keep scrolling to find out all the details on how to watch Texas square off against Detroit live.
When is Rangers vs. Tigers and when does it start? This contest between the Rangers and Tigers is on Thursday, July 2, 2026. Expect to see the opening pitch at 8:05 p.m. ET.
Where to watch Rangers vs. Tigers The Rangers and Tigers will take to the diamond at Globe Life Field for this matchup on July 2, and if you want to see the event live, get your tickets now from Vivid Seats !
What channel is the game on? You can catch this game live on RSN and DSN.

Rangers vs. Tigers Game Preview Rangers Stats, Odds & Insights The Rangers have been the moneyline favorite 43 total times this season. They’ve gone 22-21 in those games.
Texas averages 1.1 home runs per game to rank 19th in MLB play with 92 total home runs.
The Rangers’ .391 slugging percentage is 20th in baseball.
Texas’ 4.00 team ERA ranks 11th among all MLB pitching staffs.
Rangers pitchers combine for the No. 8 WHIP in MLB (1.237).
Tigers Stats, Odds & Insights This season, the Tigers have been the underdog 41 times and won 17, or 41.5%, of those games.
Detroit ranks 15th in Major League Baseball with 101 home runs.
The Tigers rank 18th in the majors with a .396 team slugging percentage.
Detroit has pitched to a 3.75 ERA this season, which ranks seventh in baseball.
The Tigers have a combined 1.228 WHIP as a pitching staff, seventh-lowest in MLB.

He is 8-7 with a 3.95 ERA and 101 strikeouts in 100 1/3 innings pitched.
In his most recent time out on Friday, the right-hander tossed seven scoreless innings against the Toronto Blue Jays while surrendering five hits.
In 16 games this season, the 36-year-old has put up an ERA of 3.95, with 9.1 strikeouts per nine innings. Opponents are hitting .243 against him.
Jung leads Texas with a .294 batting average. He’s also hit nine homers and has 32 RBI.
Jake Burger leads Texas in home runs with 14 and runs batted in with 52.
Brandon Nimmo is slashing .262/.333/.420 this season for the Rangers.
Tigers Key Players to Watch The Tigers will send Framber Valdez (4-5) to the mound for his 18th start this season.
The left-hander gave up four earned runs and allowed eight hits in six innings pitched against the Houston Astros on Saturday.
The 32-year-old has pitched in 17 games this season with an ERA of 4.05 and 7.2 strikeouts per nine innings, with an opponent batting average of .249.
McGonigle is batting .282 with 18 doubles, three triples, seven home runs and 54 walks.
Dillon Dingler has put his power on display as he paces his team with 19 home runs and 59 RBI.
Riley Greene leads the Tigers with a team-best batting average of .285.
